info.name: Create a cart for the authenticated customer

items.docs: Creates a new empty shopping cart (quote) for the currently authenticated customer. Returns the cart ID (quote ID) that is used in subsequent cart operations. A customer can only have one active cart at a time; if an active cart already exists, its ID is returned.

Adds a product to the authenticated customer's active cart. The request must include the quote_id, SKU, and quantity. For configurable products, product_option must be included with the selected option values. Returns the updated cart item object.

Creates a new empty shopping cart for a guest (unauthenticated) shopper. Returns a masked cart ID string that is used in subsequent guest cart operations. No authentication is required for this endpoint. The masked ID is a UUID-like string that does not expose internal database IDs.
